title: La CONAIE y la fuerza histórica del movimiento indígena
goal: Examine the political rise of the indigenous movement in Ecuador, the 1990 nationwide uprising, and the Pachakutik movement.
grammar: sociología del movimiento indígena, Estado Plurinacional y democracia intercultural

items: Analyze the historic 1990 Inti Raymi indigenous uprising and its transformative national impact.
Examine the foundation and parliamentary role of the Pachakutik political movement.
Deploy indigenous politics and plurinational vocabulary (levantamiento, plurinacional, nacionalidad, comunero).
